name: search
description: Ranked search over symbols, doc sections, and raw file text — preferred over native Grep. `mode=keyword` (default) is the fastest path for identifiers; `mode=regex` scans file text; `mode=nl` is a question-shaped query that defaults to code-only and falls back to BM25 when embeddings are unavailable. `scope` is a glob (`*.md`, `crates/foo/**`) that narrows both file paths and unit kinds in one knob — there is no separate `unit_kinds`/`file_pattern`. With `fuzzy=true`, fuzzy hits are labeled in `items[]` with `match_type: "exact"` (literal-equal), `"prefix"` (case-insensitive prefix), `"partial"` (BM25 token-overlap), or `"fuzzy"` (nucleo-matcher). Calibration warnings (`NO_EXACT_MATCH`, `AMBIGUOUS_IDENTIFIER`, `OVERBROAD_QUERY`) demote `confidence` to `partial` when results are suggestive rather than authoritative. Mode-conditional meta: `mode=keyword|nl` emits `_meta.tokens_saved`; `mode=regex` emits `_meta.bytes_scanned` and `_meta.files_scanned` instead — regex inherently can't beat raw `rg` on tokens, so the savings field is meaningless there. Frozen envelope: `{ok, data, _meta:{confidence, timing_ms, …}, warnings}`.

mode.description: `keyword` (default): identifier / BM25. `regex`: file-text scan. `nl`: dense / hybrid retrieval, code-only by default.

scope.description: Glob narrowing path *and* unit kind in one knob. `*.md` → docs only; `crates/foo/**` → that crate; omit for the whole repo.

limit.description: Global cap on items returned (across all files).

per_file_limit.description: `mode=regex` only: optional ripgrep-style per-file cap on hits. When set, no single file contributes more than this many hits even if `limit` would allow it. Ignored for keyword/NL.

max_tokens.description: Soft cap on serialized item bytes (~4 bytes/token).

fuzzy.description: Merge nucleo-matcher fuzzy hits into `items[]` with `match_type: "fuzzy"` / `"prefix"` / `"partial"`.

name: outline
description: Structural views — call this before reading any whole file. `view=file` returns a symbol list for one file (or batch via `paths`); `view=repo` returns a workspace summary (crates, top modules by centrality, languages). Centrality is cached in SQLite and recomputed only on reingest, so the repo view is fast on repeat calls. Frozen envelope: `{ok, data, _meta:{confidence, timing_ms, tokens_saved}, warnings}`. Repository views describe indexed files only: coverage.scope=indexed_files_only, repository_coverage_complete=false and INDEX_SCOPE_ONLY; unsupported, ignored or unindexed files may be absent.

name: read
description:
Batch-read symbols, doc sections, or bounded file ranges in one call. Refs are strings only:
  - `"path:N-M"` — line range
  - `"path:N"` — single line
  - `"path::Name#kind"` — symbol by qualified name
  - `"id:<stable_id>"` — symbol by stable id
  - `"section:path::heading"` — doc section
Whole-file reads emit `confidence: partial` with an `outline_first` hint pointing at the matching `outline` call. Per-ref `truncated: true` when `max_tokens` is exceeded. With `with_neighbors=true`, structural neighbors (import + reference graph, no string-match) are appended.

refs.description: Refs to read in input order.

context_lines.description: Lines of before/after context per ref.

max_tokens.description: Soft token budget for the combined payload (~4 bytes/token).

with_neighbors.description: Append structural neighbors (import + reference graph). No string-match neighbors.

name: references
description: Reference candidates and import-edge queries. Symbol rows use name-based grammar identifier syntax, not resolved bindings; aliases and shadowing remain unresolved and confidence is partial. `kind=symbol` enumerates references to a symbol — items carry `{file, line, column, identifier, enclosing_symbol, enclosing_kind, body_match_kind}`, where `identifier` is the searched name (not the enclosing function). Unparsed non-definition text stays in `weak_hits[]` when `include_weak=true`; symbol-reference confidence remains partial. `kind=imports` returns structural outgoing imports in `imports` and unique heuristic basename guesses in `candidate_imports`; `kind=importers` returns resolved incoming imports in `importers`, separately labeled heuristic import-resolution or name-usage candidates in `candidate_usage_importers`, unbounded totals, and truncation; structural and candidate lists share `limit`. Both import views are partial and incomplete; duplicate basename guesses remain unresolved and empty lists do not prove dependency absence. Imports/importers reject unindexed target paths. Outgoing imports also reject languages without an import extractor; incoming edges can target any indexed file.

scope.description: Optional path glob restricting where to search.

include_weak.description: Include text-mention `weak_hits[]` alongside name-based identifier syntax candidates; no binding resolution is implied.

name: impact
description: Change-oriented analyses backed by the structural reference graph. `analysis=blast_radius` returns candidate files containing definitions or name-matched grammar identifiers with partial confidence (not binding resolution; comments/string contents remain separate weak mentions; text-only evidence has unreliable confidence; never returns file-importer counts). Successful blast-radius results carry `status: "incomplete"` and `complete: false`; empty matches or `limit: 0` do not prove absence of impact. `analysis=rename_safety` reports name-based collision candidates but cannot establish binding completeness: `safe: null`, `status: "undecided"`, `complete: false`, partial confidence. `identifier_match_pct` is the fraction of syntax rather than weak text candidates, never a safety/coverage guarantee.

max_tokens.description: Soft byte budget for the response (~4 bytes/token).

name: health
description: Quality signals. `quality_signal` reports the four agent-readiness dimensions (navigability, comprehensibility, verifiability, change_safety) plus structural root causes. `hotspots` returns top-N functions by churn × cyclomatic. `dead_code` walks reachability + a string-literal-dispatch heuristic; cli/bin/hooks/main paths are capped at confidence < 0.5 with a `MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED` warning since externally-invoked entry points can't be statically reached. `repo_health` aggregates the others plus cycle count, using cached dead-code output to stay under the warm SLA. `test_gaps` ranks heuristic candidates lacking an indexed test-file dependency (not executed coverage) by `cyclomatic × (1 + fan_in) × (1 + ln(1 + churn))`. Health describes the indexed subset, with INDEX_SCOPE_ONLY and partial confidence; it is not a complete repository audit.

scope.description: Optional path prefix to scope the analysis.

include_tests.description: `dead_code`: include test files / inline test functions. Default false.

max_tokens.description: Soft token budget for the response (~4 bytes/token).
